summary: Sint Maarten (Dutch part). Parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy.
rulers: King WILLEM-ALEXANDER of the Netherlands (since 30 April 2013); represented by Governor Ajamu G. BALY (since 10 October 2022); Prime Minister Luc MERCELINA (since 3 May 2024)
government: parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy
economy: high-income, tourism-based Dutch autonomous constituent economy; severe hurricane- and COVID-19-related economic recessions; multilateral trust fund helping offset economic downturn; no property taxation; re-exporter to Saint Martin GDP (PPP): $1.986 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Police Force of Sint Maarten (KPSM)
origin: none (part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands)
